objectives.description: Describe the creation story and the fall of humanity as recorded in Genesis and draw moral lessons
Explain the accounts of Cain and Abel, Noah and the flood, and identify lessons on obedience and justice
Describe God's call of Abraham, his covenant with God, and Abraham's relationship with Lot
Recount the stories of Isaac, Jacob, Esau, and Joseph in Egypt and identify their significance for faith
Explain Moses' leadership, the Ten Commandments, and the journey of the Israelites to the Promised Land
Describe the role of the judges of Israel and identify lessons on leadership and faithfulness to God

subStrands.name: Life, Ministry, and Passion of Jesus

objectives.description: Describe the birth of John the Baptist and Jesus and explain the significance of the Annunciation
Recount the baptism, temptation, and early ministry of Jesus including his first miracle
Describe the Sermon on the Mount and explain the central teachings of Jesus on the Kingdom of God
Identify and interpret key parables of Jesus and their application to everyday Christian living
Describe the miracles of Jesus and explain how they demonstrated his divine power and compassion
Recount the events of Holy Week: the triumphal entry, the Last Supper, betrayal, trial, and crucifixion
Describe the death, burial, resurrection, and ascension of Jesus and explain their significance for Christians
Explain the Great Commission and Pentecost event and their importance for the spread of Christianity
Explain the roles of family members and apply biblical principles for healthy family relationships (Eph. 6:1–9; Col. 3:18–21)
Describe the value of a good family name and explain how Christians can uphold family honour (Prov. 22:1)
Apply biblical guidelines for choosing and maintaining healthy friendships in school (1 Sam. 18:1–5; Prov. 1:10–12)
Describe the importance of community relationships and the Christian's responsibility to community leaders
Explain the importance of fellowship, unity, and service within the church community
